name: Dynamic Linker Namespace Audit
description: Audits loaded shared libraries via dl_iterate_phdr, inspects thread comm names, and verifies file descriptor isolation traps.

evidenceUnits.title: Suspicious loaded-library path
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Shared objects enumerated by the process dynamic linker, task comm names, and anonymous trap file descriptors
evidenceUnits.proposition: A loaded object path matches an injection-related rule, or a task comm name / FD trap reveals an active runtime framework
evidenceUnits.observationChannel: dl_iterate_phdr public linker enumeration, /proc/self/task/*/comm, and anonymous FD verification
evidenceUnits.availability: Limited to objects and task directories exposed in the target process
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: In-process hooks can alter linker enumeration, task comm strings, or file descriptors
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A suspicious library path, thread name, or FD anomaly supports injection evidence but may not uniquely identify Zygisk
